model_evaluation.target: whether this exact class-room-time placement appears in the committed reference solution
model_evaluation.positive_definition: exact selected room + selected time match from committed solution
model_evaluation.negative_definition: candidate not selected in this one reference solution; not necessarily a bad placement
critical_limitations: This is a reference-placement ranking model, not a true conflict-risk model.
Unselected placements are not necessarily poor; there may be many equally valid schedules.
One benchmark solution does not establish cross-university generalization.
Reference-derived student-overlap features are excluded to prevent leakage.
The trained model ranks placements only; hard constraints are handled by scheduler code.

scheduler_results.notes: Hard constraints enforced by greedy placement are room and instructor overlaps only. Student overlap is a proxy soft penalty; group constraints/date exceptions are not enforced. Not a complete UniTime solver.

Hard constraints enforced by greedy placement are room and instructor overlaps only. Student overlap is a proxy soft penalty; group constraints/date exceptions are not enforced. Not a complete UniTime solver.

interpretation: This is a greedy prototype, not an optimal solver.
Baseline and ML-guided scheduling use the same room/instructor hard checks.
ML model target is selected-in-reference placement; unselected does not mean invalid.
No claim of full UniTime constraint satisfaction should be made.
The independent validation in this prototype covers room/instructor overlap only plus a student-overlap proxy.
